offer.text: Our blacksmith's been short of custom lately and it's wearing on them. Go strike a couple of trades at the forge — it'd lift their spirits and the village's.

accept.text: Good of you. Two trades ought to do it.

decline.text: Ah well. Coin's tight all round.

in_progress.text: Been to see the blacksmith yet?

ready.text: Heard the hammer ringing again — that's your doing.

complete.text: The smith's in good cheer now. The whole village feels it. My thanks.
